rv.q: A tale of hope and the enduring power of raising your voice in an ever scarier political climate, The Boy at the Back of the Class is a must-see for children and adults alike.
There are a lot of laughs alongside the more sombre moments and a great deal of heart.

cn.t: Critics praise this heartwarming adaptation as an emotionally powerful story of refugee acceptance told through children's eyes, with reviewers moved by its timely message of compassion and humanity.
